text:
elaine (product): quick sync — we need to nail down launch criteria for the enterprise compliance pilot. scope: audit logging + BYOK/KMS + basic retention controls for SOC2 customers. looking for field asks, technical blockers, and a proposed must-have vs nice-to-have split. can folks drop short bullets?

marta (security): must-have: per-tenant immutable audit stream (append-only), BYOK handshake + rotation notes, documented access controls for logs, encryption-at-rest verified, simple legal-hold toggle. nice-to-have: search SLA guarantees, indexed query UI, cross-region archival.

sam (eng-ops): +1 on append-only. technical constraints to call out: indexing every event blows up storage/costs; we can offer tiered retention (hot indexed last 90d, cold archived blob thereafter). need SLA targets for audit-query latency — otherwise ops will get paged. also: BYOK handshake has timing edge cases during rotate — we need an escape/fallback policy.

ryan (customer-suc): field input: several pilot customers asked explicitly for (1) ability to export logs in ndjson + parquet (for their SIEM), (2) retention configurable per-tenant 90/365/730 days, and (3) an audit evidence package for SOC2 audits (signed manifest + timeline). legal teams want the legal-hold toggle to prevent auto-deletion.

elaine (product): thanks — useful. proposal draft for pilot MVP: MUST: BYOK handshake + documented flow, append-only audit export (ndjson), retention toggle with 90/365 options, legal-hold toggle, minimal evidence package (signed manifest). NICE: parquet export, full-text indexed search, per-route query SLA. is that reasonable?

marta (security): reasonable for pilot. add requirement: key usage logs (who requested decrypt/export) visible to tenant admins. also include KMS attestation notes for customers that request FIPS/HSM certs.

sam (eng-ops): implementable if we scope indexing out of pilot. engineering ask: pilot rollout plan needs a runbook for key-rotation edgecases + fallback to platform-managed keys if customer's key unavailable. suggest automated alerting to both customer and internal on-rollover failures.

ryan (customer-suc): customer acceptance criteria we can use in contracts: export format ✅, retention options ✅, legal-hold ✅, BYOK handshake docs + support SLA (2 business days for onboarding). they will accept platform-managed key fallback only if it's documented and auditable.

elaine (product): ok action items: 1) eng to draft runbook for BYOK onboarding + rotation fallback (sam) 2) security to draft key-usage visibility and attestation notes (marta) 3) product to author evidence package template + contract language (elaine) 4) cs to collect two pilot customers willing to test (ryan). can we get rough ETA suggestions in-thread?

sam (eng-ops): ETA: runbook + fallback design: 2w. implementation for pilot (no indexing): 4w after signoff. need one spike to validate rotation failure modes (3 days).

marta (security): ETA: key-usage visibility spec + attestation checklist: 7 days. will coordinate with legal for minimal attestation wording.

ryan (customer-suc): i'll find 2 pilots in 48h and share contact-specific retention + export preferences.

ops-bot: Note: created task #COM-1342 "BYOK runbook + fallback policy" assigned to sam. due_date set to 2 weeks from now.

elaine (product): nice, thanks everyone. i'll collate and create a short launch matrix doc after we have the three specs. one quick question: should SOC2/ISO documentation be part of pilot acceptance or post-pilot? my instinct: include a basic SOC2 checklist in pilot (controls mapping), deeper ISO evidence post-pilot. thoughts?

marta (security): include basic SOC2 controls mapping in pilot (user access, audit trails, retention proof). ISO can wait — it's heavier and requires full docs.

sam (eng-ops): agree. keep pilot lean. add telemetry to measure export frequency and query latencies so we can justify indexing investment.

elaine (product): perfect. i'll update the pilot acceptance criteria and ping for final signoff in 48h. thanks all :thumbsup:
